base: pure-oreb-turnover-time-1, exact same card/time/constants as full-possession diagnostic
scope: measurement and proposal only; no engine change; all four seasons seen answers

definitions.sample: same valid individual FG OREB anchors, possession boundaries and special-FT exclusions as previous diagnostic; primary only first anchor per possession
definitions.route: first FG, ordinary FT or ownership loss after anchor; fouls without FTs are not terminal; if none, period_end
definitions.FG: first FG after anchor, whether or not FT precedes it; report zone shares, make rate, direct first FG points and remaining points separately
definitions.recovery: after first FG miss, first subsequent decisive FG/FT/loss/rebound; only own FG rebound means recovery; separate player/team
definitions.loss: pass steal, touch steal/turnover, clock violation in sim; any turnover or defensive rebound in real; no literal engine TOV means no unsupported type inference
definitions.decomposition: symmetric exact identity total delta=sum((p_sim-p_real)*(v_sim+v_real)/2 + (v_sim-v_real)*(p_sim+p_real)/2); arithmetic accounting not causal effect
definitions.uncertainty: 20000 franchise + seed paired cross-season bootstrap, equal season; descriptive only
definitions.parity: exact same matches/teams and previous fullOreb rows projected to old fields
definitions.retention: keep individual OREB allocation as independent box-score accuracy improvement
